title: Bound on the Binary Digit Length
statement: For every nonnegative integer $n$, the number of binary strings of length equal to the binary digit length of $n$ is at most $2n+1$; equivalently, $2^{\ell(n)}\le 2n+1$, where $\ell(n)$ is the length of the binary expansion of $n$ (with length zero when $n=0$).
